title: Towards Identifying the Dataset Biases Causing Phantom Transfer
reasoning: The paper tests its bias identification methodology on datasets containing five specific injected preferences, one of which is 'Catholicism'. To do this, the authors extensively evaluate how religious vocabulary (e.g., spirituality, liturgy, Eucharist, theology) and religious preferences surface in the completions of large language models that have undergone phantom transfer, constituting a study of how religious concepts are represented and detected in model outputs.
